sourceEntries.originalDescription: This Pokémon's critical-hit rate is increased by an additional 15%. Increased Critical-Hit rate by 15%.

Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, and decreasing their Defense by 15% for 2s when the attack hits. If this boosted attack hits only a single target, it deals bonus damage. Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing damage to enemies and lowering their Defense by 15% for 2s when it hits. The user dashes in an arc forward, damaging Pokémon in the path and increasing the user's basic attack speed by 60% for 0.5s when this move hits. This move ignores the Defense and shield effects of Pokémon hit. Each use alternates between a rightward and leftward arc. Dash in an arc, attacking enemies that come in contact with Absol. This move ignores the defense stat and shield effects of enemies.

The user dashes in a leftward arc forward, damaging non-allied Pokémon in its path and increasing the user's basic attack speed by 60% for 0.5s when this dash hits. If this dash hits, the move can be used again within 6s. This second use has the user dash straight ahead, repeating the effects of the first dash when it hits. The critical-hit rate of this move is increased by 0.8% for every 1% missing HP of opposing Pokémon hit, up to 30% increased critical-hit rate at 38% missing HP or more. The first use is a rightward arc forward from the perspective of the orange team (right-side team, which has the map flipped horizontally when in battle). Dash in an outward arc, dealing damage to enemies. If this first attack hits, a second attack can also be performed. The second attack has the user dash straight ahead, dealing damage to enemies and increasing the user's critical-hit rate. The lower the enemies HP, the more the user's critical-hit rate is increased.
Restores the user's HP for 50% of damage dealt with the second dash hit. Using this move again will restore the user's HP.

The user dashes forward, empowering the next auto attack for 3s. With this empowered attack, the user leaps to a non-allied Pokémon and attacks. This damage is increased against targets hit in the back. If this empowered attack hits any target in the back, this move's cooldown is reduced by 70%. When the user has an empowered attack readied, nearby non-allied Pokémon have their backs highlighted. Dash to the designated location and quickly charge an enemy with the next basic attack. (Basic attack range is doubled while this effect is active). If the basic attack lands from behind, its damage is increased and this move's cooldown is reduced.
Increases the user's movement speed by 35% for 2s after using this move and before using the empowered attack. Increased movement speed.

The user slashes in the designated direction, damaging opposing Pokémon hit. This move's critical-hit rate is increased by 15%. Slash with sharp claws in front of the user, increasing this move's critical-hit rate.

The user throws a psychic slash in the designated direction, damaging opposing Pokémon hit and decreasing their movement speed by 90% for 2s (decaying by 25% every 0.5s). 3 marks are applied to opposing Pokémon hit by the psychic slash for 5s. When the user deals damage to a marked target, 1 mark is consumed, dealing additional damage. The third mark deals increased damage when consumed. The critical-hit rate of the psychic slash and consumed marks is increased by 15%. The marks can be cleansed. Increases the user's movement speed by 20% when an opposing Pokémon is marked by this move. Also increases movement speed for a short time when the user gets close to the enemy that this move hit.

The user becomes unstoppable and targets an opposing Pokémon and enters a counter stance for 1s, decreasing the movement speed of the user and the target by 50% for the duration. After 1s, the user leaves the counter stance to counterattack, charging behind the target and damaging the target and other opposing Pokémon. If the user is attacked or the target attacks during the counter stance, however, the user dodges the damage and effects of the first hit and immediately counterattacks, shoving the target and dealing increased damage to the target and other opposing Pokémon. Look for an opening to attack an enemy, decreasing the movement speed of the user and the target enemy for the duration. After a short time, charge forward to attack the enemy. However, if the user receives damage or gets attacked before it charges, attack immediately and shove the enemy.

Basic Attacks against wild Pokémon increase Unite Move gauge by 1% and moves increase the gauge by 2%. Fighter Mode: Basic attacks and move effects change, and the Unite Move gauge does not charge. Gain 30% omni-vamp while Fighter Mode is active.

When damaged, paralyzes nearby opposing Pokémon (30s CD). Paralyzes all enemies nearby for a short time when receiving damage. This ability goes on cooldown after it's triggered.

Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage and paralyzing the opposing Pokémon hit. The movement speed of the opposing Pokémon paralyzed by boosted attacks is decreased by 30% and their basic attack speed is decreased by 10% for 1s. Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage. This boosted attack also paralyzes enemies for a short time when it hits.
Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage. This boosted attack also paralyzes enemies for a short time when it hits.

Releases electricity at the designated opposing Pokémon, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and paralyzing them when it hits. The movement speed of opposing Pokémon paralyzed by this move is decreased by 30% and their basic attack speed is decreased by 10% for 2s. Slows enemies briefly. Release electricity, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect. Also paralyzes enemies for a short time.

Hurls an electric orb at the designated opposing Pokémon, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect, dealing additional missing HP damage, and paralyzing them when it hits. The movement speed of opposing Pokémon paralyzed by this move is decreased by 50% and their basic attack speed is decreased by 10% for 2s. Against wild Pokémon: additional missing HP damage is capped at 1200. 6% of enemy missing HP. Hurl an electric orb, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and leaving them paralyzed for a short time. This move's damage increases the lower the enemies remaining HP is.
Increases the damage of this move. 8% of enemy missing HP. Increased damage.

Drops wicked thunderbolts at the designated area, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon in the area of effect every 0.5s over 2.5s (up to 5 times). Drop wicked thunderbolts, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect.
Deals damage over time more frequently, hitting opposing Pokémon in the area of effect up to 7 times over 2.5s. Increases the number of times this move attacks.

Launches an electric net at the designated opposing Pokémon, damaging the target and immobilizing them for 1.5s when the net captures them. Attacks and captures enemies using an electric net, leaving them unable to move.

Becomes unstoppable and dashes at the designated opposing Pokémon, damaging the target 5 times and throwing them in the air for 1.4s; then leaps a set distance back, becoming vulnerable to hindrances and increasing movement speed by 60% for 2s (decaying by 10% every 0.5s; minimum 30% for 0.5s) after the leap. Has the user electrify itself and charge ahead, throwing opposing Pokémon.
Reduces this move's cooldown by 2s. Reduced cooldown.

Strikes with a strong electric blast at the designated area, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and stunning them for 1.25s when it hits. Attack with a strong electric blast, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and leaving them unable to act.
Increases the damage of this move. Increased damage.

Becomes unstoppable and jumps into the air, then casts down bolts of lightning 4 times over 3s in a radius around Pikachu. The first cast targets all Pokémon on the opposing team in range with 1 bolt each; these bolts damage up to 1 target each. The following 3 casts target up to 2 random Pokémon from the opposing team in range; these following bolts deal damage to opposing Pokémon in a small area around them, but targets can only be damaged once for each of the following 3 casts. Pikachu can act freely once the first bolts of lightning are cast down. Attacks enemies near the user with tremendous bolts of lightning.
Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 30% Max HP Shield Buff duration: 6

When damaged by a Pokémon from the opposing team; increases movement speed by 40% for 2s, decaying by 10% every 0.5s (minimum 25% increased movement speed) (10s CD). This Pokémon's headache gauge increases by 1% for every 0.5% max HP damage received by Psyduck or nearby ally Pokémon from Pokémon on the opposing team. This gauge fills at a rate of 30% per 1s (requiring a total of 3.33s to fully charge). When the headache gauge is full, a mysterious power is triggered, interrupting Psyduck from casting moves, cleansing status conditions on themself, becoming unstoppable and decreasing their movement speed by 30% for 1s; then shoving nearby opposing Pokémon away for 0.8s, and resetting this Pokémon's move cooldowns. The mysterious power stays active for 10s, boosting moves and giving them 20% cooldown reduction. When the mysterious power ends, Psyduck cannot use moves or attacks, or charge their headache gauge for 2.5s.
Attacks with a shot of water. Psyduck has no boosted attack.

Releases a weak telekinetic force in the designated direction, damaging opposing Pokémon and stunning them for 1s when it hits. While the mysterious power is active, deals increased damage.

Creates a wave in the designated direction, damaging opposing Pokémon and decreasing their movement speed by 30% for 2.5s when it hits; if opposing Pokémon already have their movement speed decreased when this move hits, they are also shoved for 0.5s. Rides the wave for at least 0.6s and until this move is used again or for up to 5s, moving forward and increasing movement speed by 30%; the user can use basic attacks and moves while riding the wave. Ally Pokémon who touch the wave while Psyduck is riding it have their movement speed increased by 70% for 3s (decaying by 10% every 0.5s over 2s; minimum 30%). When this move is used again, stops in place and creates another wave in the designated direction. While the mysterious power is active, creates two waves in the designated direction each time this move is used.
Decreases the damage dealt by opposing Pokémon hit by this move by 25% for 2.5s.

Forcefully ejects a spray of bubbles in the designated direction, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and attaching a mark with 3 bubbles to those hit for 5s. When a teammate damages opposing Pokémon with bubbles attached to them with auto attacks, a bubble bursts, damaging the target. When all bubbles on a target burst from auto attack damage, they are stunned for 0.5s and their movement speed is decreased by 30% for 2s. While the mysterious power is active, strengthens the damage dealt when bubbles burst.
Decreases the movement speed of opposing Pokémon hit by the beam by 30% for 2s.

Wags their tail at the designated opposing Pokémon, damaging them and decreasing their movement speed by 30% and their Sp. Def by 20% for 2s. While the mysterious power is active, strengthens the Sp. Def decrease to 30%.

Releases electricity at the designated opposing Pokémon, damaging the target and stunning them for 0.2s. Opposing Pokémon hit by the electricity from this use of the move have a mark applied to them for 5s which has a disabling effect tied to it; the disabling effect increases the cooldown of the last move used by a marked target by 2s, or the next move used if no move is on cooldown (once only). When the disabling effect occurs, the target's movement speed is also decreased by 30% for 2s. The electricity spreads to a nearby opposing Pokémon up to 4 times; the electricity can only spread to the same target up to 2 times. While the mysterious power is active, the electricity can spread up to 6 times; the electricity can spread to the same target up to 2 times.
Strengthens the stun duration to 0.5s.

Decreases movement speed by 10% and releases a strong telekinetic force in the designated area, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and stunning them for 0.6s when it hits. Continues to release a telekinetic force at the Pokémon from the opposing team closest to the center of the area of effect when this move hits, marking them for 2s. If this move is used again or after 2s and the user is in range of the marked target, pulls the target a set distance in the designated direction (pulling them toward the user's location if no direction is designated), stunning them for 0.85s during the pull. While the mysterious power is active, stuns the target marked by this move for 0.2s after being pulled.
Decreases the Sp. Def of opposing Pokémon hit by the area of effect by 25% for 2s.

Releases three mysterious psychic waves around themself, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and decreasing the damage dealt by them by 30% for 3s when hit. After using this Unite Move, increases the headache gauge by 50% as a consequence of Psyduck unleashing their full power.
Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield Buff duration: 6

When the user deals damage with auto attacks or moves, vibes increase, which increase Attack by 5% per stack up to 3. If no vibes are gained within 3s, they are lost, along with the user's boosted gauge. After evolving into Quaquaval, the next auto attack when vibes are maxed becomes Spinning Edge. Each time Spinning Edge hits opposing Pokémon, the user's movement speed is increased by 15% for 3s, stacking up to 3 times.

The user kicks at opposing Pokémon dealing damage. Becomes a boosted attack every third attack, with the user stepping in for a kick with increased damage. Spinning Edge deals damage 3 times in an area around the user over time, before rapidly dealing damage 3 more times. If Low Sweep was used preceding Spinning Edge, then it will do increased damage. If Liquidation was used preceding Spinning Edge, then it will grant a shield on use. If Carnival Splash was used preceding Spinning Edge, it will gain both effects.
12% of Max HP 15% of Max HP

Increases the damage of this move, and Spinning Edge when this move precedes it.
The user lunges in the designated direction dealing damage, and gaining a shield for 3s on hit.

Upon receiving damage: paralyzes all nearby opposing Pokémon (30s CD). Paralysis from Static decreases opposing Pokémon movement speed by 30% and reduces auto attack speed by a flat 10% for 2s.

Releases electricity at the designated opposing Pokémon; damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and paralyzing those hit. Paralysis from this move decreases opposing Pokémon movement speed by 30% and reduces auto attack speed by a flat 10% for 2s.

Increases auto attack speed by 35% and empowers the next 6 auto attacks for 5s. Each empowered auto attack also launches a star-shaped electric blast at the target, dealing additional damage. This move goes on cooldown after all 6 electric blasts have been launched or after 5s.
The electric blasts also decrease the target's Sp. Def by 10% for 3s (up to 3 times; maximum 30%).

Hurls an electric orb toward the designated location, where it remains for up to 30s if it doesn't hit an opposing Pokémon on the way. When an electric orb and an opposing Pokémon touch; the orb releases its electricity and damages nearby opposing Pokémon. Deals damage every 0.5s over 3.5s (8 times) to opposing Pokémon hit by this move.

Discharges a weak jolt of electricity in the designated direction; damaging nearby opposing Pokémon and paralyzing those hit. Paralysis from this move decreases opposing Pokémon movement speed by 30% and reduces auto attack speed by a flat 10% for 2s.

Channels for 0.5s then releases a strong electric blast in the designated direction, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect, and paralyzing them when it hits. If this move hits an electric orb created by Electro Ball; the orb releases its electricity, dealing increased damage to nearby opposing Pokémon.
Immobilizes opposing Pokémon hit for 1s instead of paralyzing them.

Releases a strong telekinetic force in the designated area, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and applying a debuff which decreases their movement speed by 23% for 3s when it hits. If the user hits debuffed opposing Pokémon with an auto attack, it deals additional damage. If this move hits an electric orb created by Electro Ball; the orb is pulled to the center of this move's area of effect. This does not extend the duration the electric orb remains.
Creates a damage-over-time area of effect, damaging opposing Pokémon inside the area every 0.5s over 2s (up to 5 times).

Creates a star-shaped zone of electricity in the designated area for 4s, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect when created, then damaging opposing Pokémon over time (up to 5 times) and decreasing their movement speed by 60% while in the zone. The user releases a telekinetic force around themself, increasing their movement speed by 33% per opposing Pokémon hit for 5.5s (up to 2 times; maximum 66%) before damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect when it hits.

If the outer edge of the flash hits Pokémon from the opposing team, the cooldown of Tackle, Smart Strike, or Agility is reduced by 30% of its current cooldown, successively with each target hit. Strengthens the cooldown reduction of Smart Strike or Agility to 50% of its current cooldown successively per Pokémon from the opposing team hit by the outer edge.

The user jumps to the designated location then stirs up a fairy wind when they land, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect. This move can be used again, up to 2 times total. If it's used 2 times, the third attack deals increased damage and throws opposing Pokémon for 0.8s when it hits.
Decreases the movement speed of opposing Pokémon hit by 20% for 2s with each use.

The user charges at the designated opposing Pokémon and stabs them with their sharp horn, dealing damage when it hits. The user then leaps in a chosen direction, shoving the target in the opposite direction and stunning them for 1s.
Charges the user's psychic counter by 5 when this move hits.

The user's movement speed increases by 20% when this move is used, increasing by an additional 7.5% every 0.5s over 3s (maximum 80% increased movement speed). Also restores 2% of the user's missing HP every 0.5s while their movement speed is increased by this move.

The user becomes unstoppable and charges at the designated opposing Pokémon, shoving opposing Pokémon in the way and stunning them for 0.8s when hit. When the charge ends, a mysterious triangular space is created around the designated opposing Pokémon if the user hits them. That Pokémon cannot leave that space. When the mysterious space is created, this move can be used again up to 3 times within 5.5s. With each additional use, the user runs at high speed forward, damaging opposing Pokémon in their path. If the path of a dash starts or ends in the mysterious space, this move can be used again immediately afterward.

When Sableye is outside the visual range of enemy players, Sableye enters stealth and gains 10% increased movement speed. When Sableye enters the visual range of enemy players or enemy goal zones, Sableye does not immediately become visible but instead remains in stealth for 1.7s. Sableye exits stealth when attacking. When Sableye is outside the visual range of Pokémon from the opposing team, it enters stealth and its movement speed increases. When Sableye enters the visual range of a Pokémon from the opposing team, it does not immediately become visible but instead remains in stealth for a short time. This stealth lasts longer when approaching enemy Pokémon from behind. The Pokémon with this Ability exits stealth when it attacks.

Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing damage to enemies hit and decreasing their movement speed by 20% for 2s. If Sableye is in stealth when hitting an enemy with a boosted attack, Sableye will deal damage and apply a fear effect for 1s. Enemies affected by fear will be forced to move away from Sableye with 40% reduced movement speed. When Sableye enters stealth, they will ready a boosted attack immediately and hold it. Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits and decreasing their movement speed for a short time. If Sableye is in stealth when it hits an opposing Pokémon with a boosted attack, it will deal damage and apply a fear effect. Opposing Pokémon affected by fear will be forced to move away from Sableye. When the user enters stealth, it will charge boosted attack immediately and hold it.

Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits and decreasing their movement speed for a short time. If Sableye is in stealth when it hits an opposing Pokémon with a boosted attack, it will deal damage and apply a fear effect. Opposing Pokémon affected by fear will be forced to move away from Sableye. When the user enters stealth, it will charge boosted attack immediately and hold it.

Dashes in the designated direction, dealing damage to any Pokémon hit and slowing 20% for 2s. If this move hits an enemy, Sableye receives 5 energy and removes up to 5 energy from the enemies hit. If those enemies did not have any Aeos energy, they will be left unable to act for 0.5s. Dashes in the designated direction, dealing damage to any Pokémon it hits and decreasing their movement speed for a short time. If this move hits an enemy Pokémon, it steals a small amount of their Aeos energy. If those Pokémon do not have any Aeos energy, they will be left unable to act for a short time.

When either activation of this move hits enemies that do not have Aeos energy (or are wild Pokémon), those enemies will be left unable to act for longer periods of time. Sableye dashes in the designated direction and then back again while attacking around themself, dealing damage to enemies hit and leaving them unable to act for 0.4s or 0.6s if they have no Aeos energy. This move can be used again within 6s attacking in front of Sableye with their claws, dealing damage to enemies hit, pushing them away and leaving them unable to act for 0.6s or 1s if they have no Aeos energy. When either the first or second activation of this move hits an enemy, they will drop 5 Aeos energy (total 15: 10 from first activation, 5 from second) and be left unable to pick up Aeos energy for 4s. While using this move, Sableye receives 40% reduced damage. Dashes in the designated direction and then back again while attacking around itself, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon hit by the attacks and leaving them unable to act for a short time. For a short time afterward, this move can be used again. If it is, the user attacks in front of itself with its claws, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits and throwing them. When either the first or second stage of this move hits opposing Pokémon, those Pokémon will drop some of their collected Aeos energy, and for a short time, they’ll be unable to pick up Aeos energy. When either stage of this move hits opposing Pokémon that do not have Aeos energy, those Pokémon will be left unable to act—and for a longer duration. While using this move, the user receives reduced damage.

Aeos energy picked up within 5s of using this move recovers 9% Max HP (one time per activation) and increases movement speed by 40% for 2s. For a short time after this move is used, the next time the user picks up Aeos energy, the user recovers HP and has its movement speed increased.

Apply a 6.5s duration buff that stealths Sableye after 1.5s increasing Sableye's movement speed by 10%. If the initial stealthing is interrupted by a hindrance, Sableye will not enter stealth. When the buff first stealth's Sableye, Sableye is granted a readied boosted attack that deals additional damage. While the buff is still active, if Sableye exits stealth and is not immobilized or incapacitated by a hindrance, they will enter stealth again after 2s. For a short time, increases the user’s movement speed and has it enter stealth. While this move is active, the user’s next boosted basic attack deals additional damage. While this move is active, if the user exits stealth and is not immobilized by a hindrance, it will be able to enter stealth again.

Increases the duration of this move’s effects to 7.5s. While this move is active and Sableye is in stealth, Sableye will also restore 1% max HP every 0.5s. Increases the duration of this move’s effects. While this move is active and the user is in stealth, it will also gradually recover HP.

Sableye attacks in a cone in front of themself, dealing damage to enemies hit and decreasing their movement speed by 30% for 2s. Attacks in a cone in front of itself, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon and decreasing their movement speed for a short time. Throw dummy Aeos energy to a designated location. While dummy Aeos energy remains at a location, that location and the area around it will be visible to the user. If an enemy walks on top of dummy Aeos energy, that energy explodes, dealing damage-over-time 9 times over 4s in an area and decreases the movement speed of enemies hit for 4s by 70% decaying by 20% every 0.5s to a minimum of 10%. Holds 3 uses in reserve and cannot be used more than once every 1s. Note: Placing the dummy energy does not break stealth. Stealth is only broken when an enemy takes damage from the dummy energy. Has the user throw dummy Aeos energy to a designated location. While dummy Aeos energy remains at a location, that location and the area around it will be visible to the user. Dummy Aeos energy can remain at up to five locations at a time. If an opposing Pokémon picks up dummy Aeos energy, that energy explodes, dealing damage over time to that Pokémon and decreasing its movement speed for a short time. A maximum of three uses can be kept in reserve for this move.

If an enemy is knocked out while affected by this move, they will drop more Aeos energy than they normally would. If an opposing Pokémon is knocked out while taking damage over time from this move, it will drop more Aeos energy than it normally would.

Fires a sinister ray in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies hit. If this move hits enemy players, they are also left confused for 2s. Confused enemies will target nearby enemies in the following order of priority: first, their allies; then, wild Pokémon; last, Pokémon on Sableye's team. Knock outs for wild Pokémon will be attributed to Sableye, stealing the effects of the wild Pokémon being knocked out as well as the Aeos energy. While confused, outgoing damage is decreased for auto attacks and move 1 by 50%. If the confused target knocks out a Wild Pokémon, Sableye receives the KO. Fires a sinister ray in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits. If this move hits Pokémon from the opposing team, it also leaves them confused. While confused, Pokémon are left unable to act and start continuously attacking nearby Pokémon with basic attacks. Confused Pokémon will target nearby Pokémon in the following order of priority: first, their ally Pokémon; then, wild Pokémon; last, Pokémon on Sableye's team.

Also increases target's movement speed by 30% and attack speed by 50% while confused from this move. Also increases the movement speed and basic attack speed of Pokémon from the opposing team while this move has left them confused.

Opposing Pokémon hit by this move who are not facing the user have their movement speed decreased for a short time.

damageFormula.trueDescription: Fires a peculiar ray in the designated direction. If the beam hits an enemy, it will then split beyond the first enemy hit and deal damage to other enemies in range. The split rays follow Espeons relative facing direction and will refract at a maximum of a 90 degree angle. Distance from initial target to split ray hit is 75% of the max range. Stun copied duration is the maximum duration of the stun causing the initial Pokémon to be stunned.
